uv_contract.build: Normalize both U and V using (value-min)/(max-min) on EMI_glass. Embed emi-idle.png as material emi_face.
uv_contract.runtime: For exact0..1 mesh UVs: repeat.set(151/1672,136/137); offset.set((index*152+0.5)/1672,0.5/137); flipY=false; colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace.
uv_contract.legacy_runtime: For unmodified original GLB UVs ONLY: repeat.x=5/11; offset.x=index/11; repeat.y=1; offset.y=0. Original UVs already include half-texel insets.
uv_contract.filtering: ClampToEdgeWrapping on both axes, NearestFilter min/mag, generateMipmaps=false to avoid adjacent expression bleed.
